scope: Select bounded internal optimizations using retained allocation profiles and primary sources. No peer speed claims are borrowed.

sources.finding: Fallible best-effort reservation; name buckets differ from duplicate-value storage. Matches the pinned dependency.
Builder reserves its known default header count; client pooling and cheap Arc clones already correspond to Phantom behavior.
Flow-control credit and updates are peer-visible. Changing policy is a separate profile experiment, not an internal allocation optimization.
Cookie fields may be split. The existing profile's split, order and sensitivity behavior must remain intact.
Chunk reads avoid copying but retain chunk backing allocations. Phantom's pinned h3-quinn already calls ordered read_chunk.
Buffered transport has separate queue and flatten write strategies. Vectored write behavior must match the actual TLS writer and can affect record boundaries; no toggle adopted.
Moving selected client-hint fields with Vec::extract_if is available before the project's Rust 1.88 minimum; separate candidate, not mixed into map reservation.
HPACK literal length and representation must remain exact; dynamic state prevents blindly caching complete header blocks.

priorities.evidence: Retained DHAT shows three map growth allocations per template map; maps are built during both preflight and dispatch.

http2_pool::send_request validates before admission, then Http2Connection prepares again. H3 validate_wire similarly calls full preparation. Reuse must preserve validation before I/O, connection ACCEPT_CH restarts, retry and body ownership semantics. No speed estimate before measurement.

priorities.target: Client-hint placement copies and temporary vectors
priorities.evidence: place_in_slots partitions and clones owned supplied fields; profile identifies partition allocations.
Earlier 1 MiB profiles attribute churn to length-delimited reservation. Needs fragmentation, held-frame, EOF, backpressure and multiplexing controls.
Prior notification and cancellation experiments were rejected. Need source-attributed scheduling and locking measurements, not another synchronization guess.
Could retain oversized transport backing memory. Needs consumers holding collected results, not only immediately dropping them.

priorities.target: Flow-control, QPACK, ACK and connection count
priorities.evidence: Changes origin-visible transport behavior; not silently enabled.

priorities.decision: Source candidate, profile and benchmark first
priorities.evidence: vendor/http2/src/hpack/encoder.rs use_huffman computes encoded_len for conditional policies. encode_str then encodes after a placeholder and shifts long literal bytes to insert the length prefix. Reusing the known length may avoid the shift. No runtime benefit measured; every policy and exact bytes at length boundaries must remain intact.
